row.name: EPAM Systems Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 5 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=4 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.21 tightness=0.68 base_volume_vs_leg=0.64 base_volume_vs_avg=0.7
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 5.5% vs its 20-SMA, 16.1% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst gain is only 2.96%, well below the 4% minimum that defines a range-expansion day, and volume came in at 81% of the prior session — the burst bar itself fails on both the gain threshold and volume confirmation. On top of that, the checklist flags this as breakout number 5 of a 53-session, 57% move, meaning the trend is deeply extended and the setup is a late-stage push, not a young burst. The consolidation box in the upper-right shows several overlapping bars with visible red closes, and the stock is already 16% above its 20-day average over the last 20 sessions.
claude.key_risk: A fifth breakout attempt on a 57% extended move with sub-average volume is the classic setup for a failed burst and a sharp reversal back into the base.
claude.entry_note: Skip if tomorrow opens below today's close of 117.91 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest — there is no margin for a weak open given the extension and volume failure.

row.summary: EPAM: +3.0% out of a base 8.5% deep. skip 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
